acceptanceCriteria: reconcile and stage either work on a non-fixture queue with tests, or stay refused with the reason recorded in the owning spec.
release create/update/close commit on a non-fixture queue with null importMapSha256, with a named TestCAL or TestREL test, and the owning spec records the requirement.
body:
S1 of docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md (CAL-V0-001, amendment A14) lets the writer apply ticket mutations, import, pause, unpause and policy update to a queue whose fixture is false. Three paths still refuse non-fixture queues: release mutations (internal/tasks/store/release.go, the fixture and executionCutover guard), reconcile (internal/tasks/store/reconcile.go, two guards), and staging an observation (internal/tasks/snapshot/stage_observation.go). Beamfall's queue keeps its milestones as releases (.taskman/releases/v0-9.json, v1-0.json), so moving that queue onto a non-fixture store needs release writes before corvint-tasks can take over Beamfall task management. Each path needs a requirement (an amendment to the leases spec or its owning spec) and a test, rather than only removing the guard.
